# Tests allowed to skip in CI (read by .github/scripts/check-test-skips.py).
# One `Class.testMethod` per line, each with the reason its skip depends on
# the runner rather than on the code. Every other skip fails the job: in
# particular the signature, updater and relauncher tests that need the
# built app must always run (the unit job builds the app first for them).

# Both use publishedHeights(for:), which skips when an offscreen WKWebView
# sends no height report within 1.5 s (HTMLBodyHeightLoopTests.swift:71).
# That depends on the runner's WebKit timing: main's CI on 2026-11-23
# skipped the second and ran the first.
HTMLBodyHeightLoopTests.testViewportSizedMailSettlesInOneHeight
HTMLBodyHeightLoopTests.testViewportLengthsArePinnedNotCollapsed
